visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair sits in a black ergonomic mesh chair facing a large computer monitor in a cluttered indoor workspace. He wears a black t-shirt featuring a white butterfly and floral graphic with a gold chain necklace. The desk is filled with a white keyboard, pink mouse, various electronic components, and several cables connected to a computer case. (2) The man turns away from the desk toward the camera, holding a white cylindrical device wrapped in bubble wrap and plastic film. He begins to unwrap the device with both hands, revealing a compact white projector with a circular black lens and a small stand. The background shows a white wall and shelving holding more tech equipment. (3) The white projector is placed on a light-colored wooden table in a dimly lit room. A bright, glowing blue light emanates from its front lens, projecting a rectangular image onto a white wall. The room contains a black leather sofa and various household items in the background. (4) A screen recording or projected interface displays an Android-based smart menu with visible app icons for Netflix, YouTube, and Google Play. The man uses a small black remote control to navigate the system, showcasing various anime and gaming scenes that are projected with high brightness and color onto the wall. (5) A close-up shot of the projector's rear panel shows its connectivity interface, including a USB port, an HDMI port, and a power input jack with cables plugged in. The camera moves to show a large black cylindrical subwoofer with a yellow 'CROWN' logo on the floor, suggesting a full home theater setup.
